text:
sam: Heads-up — I'm onboarding mpt-7b-awq into staging. Need quick smoke/QA: weights location, tokenizer quirks, config validation, AWQ calibration data, and accuracy tradeoff review. Can owners ping in? /cc @lee @ana @mia
lee: I can take weights verification. Where are the artifacts?
sam: weights at s3://redwood-models/mpt/mpt7b/awq/v2/weights.tar.zst — README + config.json included.
lee: pulling now. quick ls shows config.json, tokenizer.json, quant_meta.pb. I'll validate sha and file layout.
nana: (typo) ana: I'll run tokenizer smoke — last time mpt had an EOS-handling quirk, want to confirm preproc matches serving path.
mia: AWQ calib data lives at s3://redwood-calib/mpt7b/shortpass-10k — note it's BPE-non-merged subset. Use tokenizer v1.2 to match training artifacts.
oliver: We should run a small GPTQ baseline too for apples->apples. I'll spin up a quick GPTQ-8 run and AWQ run and compare LM eval. Need GPU quota for a couple of hours.
sam: quota bumped for staging pool; approved for eng-ml. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary after smoke passes?
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: group=quant-canary-2, start_ts=2054321500.
lee: found a config mismatch: config.json had "kv_cache": false. For serving we need kv_cache=true and compatible kv path. Opening PR now.
lee: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/912 — updates config + runtime tags.
nana: ana: tokenizer smoke notes — leading-space tokenization differs when normalize=true. I'll add a small normalization step in preprocess and tests.
mia: initial AWQ morning run shows ~2.4% token-level LM perplexity delta vs fp16 baseline on the eval set. Latency improvement ~1.9x. We should define acceptable threshold; I'd be comfortable up to 3% for this class of model but want signoff.
oliver: agree on threshold, but let's also check longer-context samples (>=1024) — AWQ kv behavior can diverge. I'll run 2 long-context evals.
sam: tagging model-governance for formal approval. @lee @ana please attach the eval harness and PR links.
lee: added smoke harness + config validation script: `tools/quant/smoke_check.sh` — sample run:
```
./tools/quant/smoke_check.sh --model s3://redwood-models/mpt/mpt7b/awq/v2 --tokenizer tokenizer.json --calib s3://redwood-calib/mpt7b/shortpass-10k
```
Output logs go to /tmp/smoke-2054321123.log
ana: will run tokenizer tests tonight and paste logs in thread. :thumbsup:
mia: uploading AWQ calib artifacts to s3://redwood-calib/2054321123/mpt7b-awq/ — includes eval summaries and sample generations.
oliver: if AWQ loss >3% on either short or long eval we'll fallback to GPTQ-8 or try FP8 profile. Creating FP8 baseline job now.
qa-bot: CI note — quant-smoke job started (job_id=qs-7781). Expect ~45m runtime. Posting status updates in thread.
sam: thanks everyone. Let's reconvene tomorrow 10:30 PT for decision. If no blockers and smoke + eval OK, proceed with canary at 2054321500.
lee: one more: I updated serving config to include `allowed_quant_variants: ["awq","gptq8","fp8"]` so routing fallback is automatic. PR has tests.
nana: noted — I'll add tokenizer normalization unit test to the PR.
mia: uploaded final eval CSVs, link: s3://redwood-calib/2054321123/mpt7b-awq/eval_summary.csv
sam: perfect. Thread closed for now — we'll post results and next steps after CI/eval finish. :rocket:
